reasons: The cited Section 18.1 matches the preferred position on every material term: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year.
Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, satisfying the remaining preferred element.
Vendor is the obligated party, so the clause benefits us; compliant status is correct and no redline or comment is expected.
